title: sphere
body:
## sphere

Creates a native Part::Sphere, a full ball centred at origin. Choose it for ball ends, spherical cavities (cut it from a block) or test solids with the analytic volume 4/3·π·r³. It produces a solid.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Schemaxis assigns its own default radius of 10 mm; FreeCAD's native 5 mm default is never used.
- Covered by the eight-fixture analytic-volume acceptance run (verification/2026-09-19-adaptor-expansion.json); not exhaustively qualified.

Native binding: `Part::Sphere`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | Radius of the sphere, in millimetres (Part::Sphere Radius). | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `10` |
| `origin` | World coordinates [x, y, z] of the sphere's centre (its placement base). | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
